description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the ExternalEventConfiguration feature within the Apache Fineract project. It tests fetching and updating external event configurations via REST API requests using RestAssured, and verifies behaviors with JUnit assertions.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing external event configuration REST endpoints in the Fineract system. It includes setup and teardown methods, as well as test cases for fetching and updating configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured, configures request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all external event configurations and compares them against default configurations.

methods.name: verifyAllEventConfigurations
methods.description: Helper method to verify that actual configurations contain all expected default configurations.

methods.name: updateExternalEventConfigurations
methods.description: Tests updating external event configurations and asserts successful updates.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets configurations to default after each test.
